Note.Text20:
findings:
topic: cross-paper inheritance
finding: 2025 paper explicitly reports primary/secondary staining temperatures and different working dilutions/washes from A131. Streptavidin temperature and final storage temperature remain unreported.

Note.Text21:
findings:
topic: marker branches
finding: TUBB3, NeuF, CGRP and TH represent alternative nerve-marker combinations with CD31/Emcn, not demonstrated simultaneous four-nerve-marker staining.

Note.Text22:
findings:
topic: denominator
finding: Nerve volume density uses region volume; vessel phenotype fraction uses total segmented vessel volume; periosteal/dural nerve fraction uses segment counts. These are neither animal counts nor interchangeable volume fractions.

Note.Text23:
findings:
topic: measurement scale
finding: SplitObjects seed diameter does not prove uniform physical section length. Whole-mount optical views and the separate 30-micrometre cryosection branch remain distinct; no universal slice thickness is inferred.

Note.Text24:
findings:
topic: sample identity
finding: Ages P0/W4/W12/W40/W80 are cross-sectional endpoints, not longitudinal within-animal timepoints. Donated W80 cohort identity, sex and panel-specific biological n are not invented.
